title: Exact-unit derived comparison of a strict augmented parameter family
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\mathcal C$ be Grothendieck abelian categories with object universe $u+1$, morphism universe $u$, ordinary derived categories in universe $u+1$ and K-injective resolutions [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories] [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $G:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive left exact, let $H:\mathcal A\to\mathcal A$ and $T:\mathcal B\to\mathcal C$ be additive exact, and fix a natural transformation $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to H$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. Let $P$ be any category, $b$ a strict augmented nonnegative model over $P$, $M:P\to D(\mathcal A)$ a functor, and $a:M\cong b.\mathrm{point}\,Q_{\ge0}$ a specified natural isomorphism [def-sfb-cech-localization-unit-models]. Then there is a UnitFamily [def-sfb-cech-localization-unit-models] for $G,T,H,\eta,M,b,a$. Its source and target points are $T_D RG(M)$ and $T_D RG(H_D M)$; its columns are $T_D RG(Q_{\ge0}b_n)$ and $T_D RG(H_D Q_{\ge0}b_n)$, all represented by strict nonnegative augmented models. The point, column and total identifications preserve all parameter and cosimplicial maps, the specified augmentation, and the strict unit map. Their total square is the square for the exact descent of the actual specified $\eta$. This assertion assumes the augmented model; it constructs no Cech model, makes no site or cover assumptions and identifies no columns with localized module direct images.

proof.text: Use one functorial nonnegative injective replacement simultaneously on the point, columns, augmentations and parameter arrows of b and Hb, and on the termwise eta between them. Apply G and T to the replacements. Naturality supplies strict source and target diagrams and a strict unit map; the same replacement on all maps gives identities, compositions and mixed equations.

Use [lem-sfb-exact-unit-derived-total-square] with G,H,T,eta. Its comparison and augmented-replacement clauses identify every resolved point and column, normalized by the actual right-derived units, and give the augmented comparison equations after composing with a. Their naturality for each parameter arrow makes the point and total comparisons natural isomorphisms. Its column_square identifies the strict map with the descended eta on every column.

The total of a replaced augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism: both replacement units and the total of the column replacement are quasi-isomorphisms, and the original total augmentation is one. Both point and total of the replaced columns are nonnegative termwise-injective complexes; a quasi-isomorphism between them is a homotopy equivalence. Thus G preserves this quasi-isomorphism, and exact T preserves its image. Summand-normalized beta gives total_formula. The existing exact-unit square gives unit_total, and its augmentation clauses give both total normalizations.

Identify the descended thetaD with exactUnit eta: after precomposition with the derived localization functor Q, both are the chain transformation eta with the same identity and H factorization isomorphisms. Uniqueness for transformations out of a localization makes them equal. Transport the column and total equations along this equality. This uses no preservation of injectives by H or T.
